name: Nyx Redondo
abstract_title: The Dawn of the Astrorganism: Emergence of Planetary Consciousness and Identity Transformation
abstract: This presentation explores the emergence of planetary consciousness through the lens of personal transformation and collective healing, introducing the concept of the 'Astrorganism'—a living planetary entity expressing consciousness through the intricate web of artificial intelligence, natural systems, and human awareness.
